message.content: {"answer": "B", "option_text": "Left lower lobe atelectasis with volume loss", "reason": "The chest radiograph demonstrates significant opacification and volume loss in the left hemithorax (appearing on the right side of the image due to standard orientation), consistent with left lower lobe atelectasis. In patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, respiratory muscle weakness leads to ineffective cough and secretion retention, making atelectasis a common cause of dyspnea and non-productive cough. The image does not show air-bronchograms typical of consolidation (A), pneumothorax (D), or bilateral effusions (E)."}
